meaning:
§ Nisroch = "the great eagle"
an idol of Nineveh worshipped by Sennacherib; symbolised by the eagle-headed human figure

elsewhere.note: As he was worshiping in the house of Nisroch his god, Adrammelech and Sharezer struck him with the sword; and they escaped into the land of Ararat. Esar Haddon…
